title: HistoryV1
description: A history: the dispatches of one application, in order, each with its recorded outcome. It generalises the acceptance vectors of a model document: a vector is an event with a response, and an event may also record the refusal a dispatch ended in. Replay re-executes every event against a build and compares outcomes byte for byte. Its digests cover its canonical JSON with no trailing newline. Design: docs/proposals/284-histories-replay.md.

application.description: The name of the application when it was recorded, or null. Information for a person; replay never compares it.

recordedFrom.description: The build the history was recorded from. Absent for a closure. Information for a person; replay never compares it, because the point of a replay is to run a different build.

events.description: The dispatches in the order they ran. A history of nothing proves nothing, so at least one is required.

oneOf.description: The dispatch ended in a refusal or a trap, named by its stable code.

Hex.description: Bytes as lowercase hex, two characters each. Hex has one spelling per value, so a digest has one meaning.

PrismDigestSet.description: Exactly sha256 and blake3, lowercase hex, over the same bytes (ADR-015).
